name: compact-component-usage
goal: Component cards show one uncategorized Used In list of at most three consumer links, followed by an ellipsis only when more consumers exist.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Current component cards group consumers under Pages/Shells/Components and show all seven AccountMenu consumers. Requested: one list, first three links, ellipsis only for overflow.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Existing usage tests checked scope and empty consumers, but not the 3-link boundary or grouped labels. New unchanged unit cases cover 0/1/3/4/7 consumers in current and historical scopes; existing browser host tests now reject category labels.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Committed regression 406b2b324 fails with expected 4 to be 3 and category headings still present; loop record --phase red preserved immutable proof. The unchanged browser regression fails at all three widths (expected zero category labels, received one), with before screenshots captured and inspected.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Opus 5.5 extended the existing flat shared usage footer with an optional unbounded-by-default limit. Only component cards pass flat layout and limit 3; overflow is a visible ellipsis with accessible omitted-consumer count. Other card variants remain unchanged.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
